document.title: The Key
document.logline: A woman returns to her childhood home and finds a key that should not exist.

global_rules: Maintain prop continuity within a scene.
Weather and lighting must not contradict prior scenes.

cast.name: Mara
cast.visual_identity: 30s female, guarded neutrality, precise and restrained movement. Charcoal wool coat, black knit top, silver ring on right index finger. Left cheek scar visible.

locations.name: Mara's Apartment
locations.spatial_rules: Door on frame right, window on frame left. Camera axis: entry to window. Dark worn wood floors.

scenes.heading: INT. MARA'S APARTMENT - NIGHT
scenes.detail: Establish isolation and introduce the impossible object.

shots.image_prompt: Wide shot, full room with Mara occupying the right third. Mara enters from frame right and stops beside the table. Rain-streaked window in foreground, Mara in midground, sealed door in background. Cool moonlight from camera left, warm practical lamp. Cinematic photorealism, subtle 35mm grain, 9:16 aspect ratio. --no extra doors, no changing room geometry
action: Mara enters from frame right, walks slowly, stops beside the table.
shots.video_prompt: A slow lateral tracking shot searches the apartment as Mara enters from frame right and stops beside the table. Keep Mara, the sealed door, and the rain-streaked window spatially consistent. Cinematic photorealism, 24fps, subtle 35mm grain. --no extra doors, no changing room geometry, no camera shake

shots.image_prompt: Close-up on the brass key lying on the table. Rain streaks visible through the window behind. Cool moonlight catches the tarnished surface. Key in focus, background softly blurred. Cinematic photorealism, subtle 35mm grain, 9:16, macro-level detail. --no Mara's hand, no extra objects on table
action: Static close-up on the brass key resting on the table.
Rain streaks slide past the window in background.
shots.video_prompt: Static close-up on the brass key resting on the table as rain streaks slide past the window in the background. Focus on the tarnished brass surface catching moonlight. Cinematic photorealism, 24fps, 9:16, subtle 35mm grain, macro-level detail. --no hand, no extra objects

scenes.heading: INT. MARA'S APARTMENT / HALLWAY - CONTINUOUS
scenes.detail: Mara discovers the key unlocks a door that should not exist.

shots.image_prompt: Mara and Elena stand before the sealed door. Elena holds the brass key up to the moonlight. The door seam glows faintly. Two-shot, medium framing. Cool moonlight, warm practical lamp. Cinematic photorealism, subtle 35mm grain, 9:16. --no extra characters, no visible hallway beyond door
dialogue: ELENA: (barely audible) You still have it.
MARA: It was never supposed to be here.
action: Elena steps into frame from the left, holding the key up.
Mara's hand tightens on the table edge.
The key catches moonlight, revealing its three teeth.

continuity.in: Key on table, Mara's hand tense

shots.video_prompt: Two-shot of Mara and Elena before the sealed door. Elena holds the brass key up to the moonlight; the door seam glows faintly. Micro push-in as Elena speaks. Keep spatial consistency with Scene 1's room layout. Cinematic photorealism, 24fps, 9:16, subtle 35mm grain. --no extra characters, no visible hallway beyond door

edit_plan.storage_directions: Store all generated takes in the channel bucket under /grudge-nudges/GN-E001/takes/. Keep inline shots sequential. Do not generate B-roll filler until primary continuity is locked. Re-prompts get take 02 with the same global shot number.
